Aliasing.description: How square and saw waves handle high notes (`layers[].aliasing`).

oneOf.description:
Smooth each jump in the wave (band-limited), so high notes stay
clean. The very top of the sound gets a little softer.

The raw wave, as on old sound chips: bright, with extra tones on
high notes.

Arpeggio.description: Stepped pitch offsets, the classic chiptune arpeggio.

repeat.description: Loop the steps (`true`, default) or hold the last step (`false`).

step_time.description: Length of each step in seconds, range 0.001..=30. Default `0.05`.

steps.description:
Pitch offsets in semitones, played in order. At least one step,
each in -96..=96. Example: `[0, 4, 7]` is a major chord.

oneOf.description: Straight line in the value's own unit (Hz).
Constant rate of change in octaves: musically even pitch sweeps.

Effect.description:
One effect in a chain. Selected by the `type` field.

Every effect has a `mix` in 0..=1: `0` is fully dry, `1` is fully wet.

delay.description: Delay time in seconds, range 0.001..=5. Default `0.25`.

feedback.description: How much of each echo feeds the next, range 0..=0.99. Default `0.4`.

damping.description: High-frequency damping of the tail, range 0..=1. Default `0.5`.

decay.description:
Time in seconds for the tail to fall by 60 dB, range 0.05..=10.
Default `1.0`.

drive.description: Input gain before shaping, range 1..=100. Default `2`.

oneOf.description: Bit depth and sample rate reduction.

rate.description:
Sample-and-hold rate in Hz, range 100..=192000. Omit to keep the full
sample rate.

Envelope.description:
Volume envelope, all times in seconds (each 0..=30).

Shape: rise to 1 over `attack`, stay at 1 for `hold`, fall to `sustain`
over `decay`, stay there for `sustain_time`, fall to 0 over `release`.
The layer length is the sum of the five times.

attack.description: Time to rise from 0 to full level. Default `0.005`.

decay.description: Time to fall from full level to `sustain`. Default `0.2`.

hold.description: Time held at full level. Default `0`.

release.description: Time to fall from `sustain` to 0. Default `0`.

Filter.description: A resonant 2-pole filter with an optional cutoff sweep.

cutoff.description: Cutoff frequency in Hz at the start, range 10..=20000. Default `2000`.

cutoff_end.description: Cutoff at the end of the sweep in Hz. Omit for a fixed cutoff.

sweep_time.description:
Sweep length in seconds, range 0.001..=30. Omit to sweep over the
whole layer.

Frequency.description: A frequency: a number in Hz, or a note name in scientific pitch notation (letter A-G, optional # or b, octave -1..9; A4 = 440 Hz, C4 = middle C).

Layer.description:
One sound layer: an oscillator shaped by an envelope, pitch curve, filter
and optional effects.

aliasing.description:
How `square` and `saw` handle high notes. `clean` (default) smooths
each jump in the wave, so high notes do not fold back into harsh
extra tones ("aliasing"). `retro` keeps the raw wave of old sound
chips, as Duck Echo made it before this option. Sine, triangle and
noise sound the same either way.

duty.description:
Pulse width for `square`, range 0.01..=0.99. Ignored by other
sources. Default `0.5`.

effects.description: Per-layer effect chain, applied in order before mixing.

name.description: Optional name for humans and agents.

offset.description:
Start time of this layer in seconds from the start of the sound,
range 0..=30. Default `0`.

pan.description:
Stereo position, -1 (left) ..= 1 (right), equal-power. Only used
when the recipe has `channels = 2`. Default `0` (centre).

gain.description: Linear gain applied to the mix, range 0..=4. Default `1.0`.

normalize.description:
Scale the final render so its peak sits at `normalize_peak_db`.
Offline only. Default `false`.

normalize_lufs.description:
Scale the render so its loudness, as `analyze` measures it, is this
many LUFS, range -60..=0. Replaces `normalize` and
`normalize_peak_db`; the peak never goes above -1 dBFS, so a target
that needs more gain renders quieter (the render result warns).
Offline only. Default: off.

normalize_peak_db.description: Target peak in dBFS when `normalize` is on, range -40..=0. Default `-1`.

trim_silence.description:
Cut the end of the render after the last sample above -60 dBFS (the
analyzer's silence threshold). Removes the silent part of computed
effect tails. Offline only; has no effect when `duration` is set.
Default `false`.

bar.description:
The bar `beat` is counted from. Bars count from 1. Default `1`, so
that `beat` alone counts from the start of the song.

beat.description:
When the note starts, in beats after the bar line. `0` is on the
bar line, `0.5` half a beat later. Required.

length.description:
How long the note is held, in beats. Default `1`. Not used by kit
pieces, which always play their whole sound.

note.description:
What to play: a note name such as `"C5"`, a number in Hz, a list of
these for a chord, or on a kit track the name of a piece such as
`"kick"`. Required.

velocity.description:
How hard the note is played, 0..=1. It multiplies the volume.
Default `1`.

anyOf.description:
A note name such as `"C5"`, or on a kit track a piece name such as
`"kick"`.

NotePitch.description: One pitch: a frequency, or a name.

NoteValue.description: What a note plays: one pitch, or several at once (a chord).

PatternNote.description:
One note in a pattern. Like [`Note`], without `bar`: a pattern's beats
count from the bar it is placed at.

beat.description:
When the note starts, in beats after the start of the pattern.
Beat `beats_per_bar` is the first beat of the next bar. Required.

length.description: How long the note is held, in beats. Default `1`.

note.description:
What to play: a note name, a number in Hz, a list of these for a
chord, or on a kit track the name of a piece. Required.

velocity.description: How hard the note is played, 0..=1. Default `1`.

Pitch.description:
Pitch over time. Frequencies are numbers in Hz (range 1..=20000) or note
names such as `"C5"`, `"F#3"`, `"Bb2"` (A4 = 440 Hz).

curve.description: Shape of the sweep from `start` to `end`. Default `linear`.

end.description:
Frequency at the end of the sweep: Hz or a note name. Omit for a
constant pitch.

start.description:
Frequency at the start of the layer: Hz or a note name such as
`"A4"`. Default `440`.

sweep_time.description:
Sweep length in seconds, range 0.001..=30. Omit to sweep over the whole
layer. After the sweep the pitch stays at `end`.

Placement.description: A pattern placed on a track.

bars.description:
The bars the pattern starts at, such as `[1, 2, 4]`. Bars count
from 1. Required.

pattern.description: The name of a pattern in `patterns`. Required.

transpose.description:
Move every note up (or down, when negative) by this many semitones,
range -48..=48. Default `0`. Not used by kit pieces.

Recipe.description:
A complete sound recipe. This is the root document of a `.toml` file or a
JSON tool call.

channels.description:
Output channels: `1` (mono, default) or `2` (stereo). In stereo each
layer is placed with its `pan`.

description.description: Optional one-sentence description. Not used by the renderer.

duration.description:
Force the total output length in seconds, range 0.001..=60.
When omitted the length is computed from the layers and effect tails.

effects.description: Master effect chain, applied in order to the mixed layers.

layers.description: The sound layers, mixed together. At least one layer is required.

master.description: Master output stage, applied after the master `effects`.

name.description: Optional name for humans and agents. Not used by the renderer.

sample_rate.description: Output sample rate in Hz. Range 8000..=192000. Default `44100`.

seed.description:
Random seed. Same recipe + same seed = byte-identical audio.
Drives the noise source and the `variation` jitter. Default `0`.

tags.description:
Optional tags for search, such as `["pickup", "bright"]`. Not used by
the renderer.

variation.description:
How much the seed may jitter pitch and envelope times, 0..=1.
`0` (default) means the seed only affects noise. `1` jitters pitch by
up to +-3 semitones and envelope times by up to +-30%.

version.description: Schema version. Must be `0` for this version of Duck Echo. Required.

oneOf.description: Pulse wave with `duty` width. The classic chip sound.

Track.description: One track: an instrument and the notes it plays.

instrument.description:
The instrument: a name from the song's `instruments` or `kits`, a
built-in instrument, `preset:NAME`, or a recipe file (a path ending
in `.toml` or `.json`, relative to the song file). Required.

name.description:
A short unique name, such as `"bass"`. Used in reports, by `solo`
and `mute`, and to pick the track's seed stream. Required.

notes.description: Notes written straight on the track.

play.description: Patterns placed at bars. Added to `notes`.

volume.description: Track level in the mix, range 0..=2. Default `1`.

delay.description: Seconds before the vibrato starts, range 0..=30. Default `0`.

depth.description: Wobble depth in semitones (peak), range 0..=48. Default `0.5`.

rate.description: Wobble rate in Hz, range 0..=100. Default `6`.

description:
A song: tracks of notes played by instruments. This is the root document
of a song `.toml` file or JSON tool call. A document with `tracks` is a
song; a document with `layers` is a recipe.

bars.description:
Length of the song in bars. When omitted, the song ends at the bar
line after its last note. Sound still ringing (releases, reverb)
plays on after the last bar.

beats_per_bar.description: Beats in one bar, range 1..=16. Default `4`.

description.description: Optional one-sentence description. Not used by the renderer.

effects.description: Song-wide effect chain, applied in order to the mix of all tracks.

instruments.description:
The song's own instruments, by name. Each is a full recipe. A track
uses one by writing its name as `instrument`.

kits.description:
The song's own drum kits, by name. A kit maps piece names (such as
`kick`) to instruments: a name from `instruments`, a built-in
instrument, `preset:NAME`, or a recipe file.

master.description:
Master output stage for the whole song, the same table as in a
recipe. Applied after the song `effects`.

name.description: Optional name for humans and agents. Not used by the renderer.

patterns.description: Named groups of notes, placed on tracks with `play`.

sample_rate.description: Output sample rate in Hz. Range 8000..=192000. Default `44100`.

seed.description:
Random seed. Same song + same seed = byte-identical audio. Each
track and each note gets its own stream from it. Default `0`.

tags.description: Optional tags for search. Not used by the renderer.

tempo.description: Speed in beats per minute, range 20..=400. Required.

tracks.description: The tracks, mixed together. At least one is required.

version.description: Schema version. Must be `0` for this version of Duck Echo. Required.

title: Duck Echo song v0
